title: Mr. Church
description: When a young girl and her dying mother are joined by a black male cook who comes to live with them, little do they know that their lives are about to change forever.

title: 10 Items or Less
description: Researching a role at a grocery store, an actor (Morgan Freeman) bonds with a feisty cashier (Paz Vega) who is preparing to interview for a new job.

title: A Miami Tail
description: The women of Liberty City protest the disrespect of women by refusing sex to their gangbanging boyfriends.

title: Who Made the Potatoe Salad?
description: "Family Matters" mainstay Jaleel White headlines this direct-to-video urban comedy about a police officer who travels to Los Angeles to meet his fiancée's family.

title: Highway
description: Two brothers search for a mythical highway in Kentucky that leads to a marijuana nirvana.

title: The Janky Promoters
description: Two shady concert promoters get in over their heads when they try to organize a concert headlined by rapper Young Jeezy.

title: School Dance
description: A teen (Bobb'e J. Thompson) hopes to impress a girl he likes by winning a spot on his school's hottest dance crew.

title: We the Party
description: A smart but underachieving teen (Mandela Van Peebles) sets his sights on a brainy classmate (Simone Battle) who is driven to succeed.

title: Video Girl
description: After a knee injury, an aspiring ballerina (Meagan Good) lands a glamorous new career in hip-hop, but soon finds that fame has a dark side.

title: Fled
description: Escaped convicts (Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin) fight while they evade authorities seeking a computer disk on Cuban mobsters.

title: Rosemary's Baby
description:
S01 E01 — Night 1
After a personal tragedy, Rosemary and Guy head to Paris, where Guy has landed a teaching job at the Sorbonne; the young couple realize their new apartment has a haunted past.

title: Rosemary's Baby
description:
S01 E02 — Night 2
As Guy finds success, Rosemary's health declines during the course of her pregnancy; Roman and Margaux take a peculiar interest in the couple.

title: Iron Eagle on the Attack
description: Students at a retired fighter pilot's (Lou Gossett Jr.) flight school for troubled youths stumble on a military plot to attack Cuba with chemical weapons.

title: Leprechaun in the Hood
description: When three rappers want to get even with a pimp, they accidentally unleash a leprechaun who goes on a killing rampage in tha 'hood.

title: Leprechaun: Back 2 tha Hood
description: When Emily Woodrow and her friends happen on a treasure chest full of gold coins, they encounter trouble with a very nasty and protective Leprechaun.

title: The Rhythm
description: Robert transforms a group of roller skaters into a championship-caliber ice-hockey team by harnessing their natural talent and passion, but they must confront racism and discrimination in the predominantly white world of the sport.

title: The Son of No One
description: A rookie police officer (Channing Tatum) who once killed a pair of junkies in his youth remains haunted by the incident.

title: Judgment Day
description: In 72 hours a meteor will collide with Earth and annihilate mankind. Singapore's government tells its citizens to let loose for once and do absolutely anything they please.

title: Traffik
description: A couple and their two friends embark on a weekend getaway to an isolated estate in the mountains. They soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when members of a violent biker gang show up to protect their secrets from the outside world.

title: Caught in the Crossfire
description: Two detectives (Chris Klein, Richard T. Jones) are targeted by gangsters and crooked cops as they investigate an important case.

title: The Wash
description: Two roommates (Dr. Dre, Snoop "Doggy" Dogg) who work at a car wash must save their kidnapped boss (George Wallace) in order to keep their jobs.

title: Fifty Shades of Black
description: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," wealthy entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) introduces a young woman (Kali Hawk) to his kinky world of S&M.

title: Meet the Blacks
description: A Chicago man (Mike Epps) moves his family to Beverly Hills, Calif., on the same day when all crime becomes legal for a 12-hour period.

title: Next Day Air
description: A courier (Donald Faison) lands in the middle of a drug deal gone awry when he accidentally delivers a box of cocaine to the wrong address.

title: Triple Threat
description: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

title: Armed Response
description: Trained operatives find themselves trapped inside an isolated military compound after its artificial intelligence is suddenly shut down. There, they begin to experience strange and horrific phenomena.

title: The Island
description: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

title: Beat Street
description: A student composer (Rae Dawn Chong) inspires South Bronx residents to new heights in break dancing, rap music and graffiti.

title: Lee Daniels' The Butler
description: A White House butler (Forest Whitaker) has a front-row seat to history through three decades and seven presidential administrations, including those of Eisenhower (Robin Williams), Kennedy (James Marsden) and Nixon (John Cusack).

title: How I Learned to Fly
description: Two African-American teenage boys are suddenly and mysteriously abandoned by their parents, forcing them to learn how to survive on their own. From this desertion, comes an experience of beauty, meaning and enduring love.

title: Uninvited Guest
description: A screenwriter, his neglected wife and their guests become the prey of a deadly stranger who arrives on their doorstep.

title: A Murder of Crows
description: A lawyer (Cuba Gooding Jr.) must prove he is innocent of murder after passing a dead man's tale of intrigue off as his own.

description: A filmmaker returns to Detroit to bury his stepfather and settle his accounts, but his struggles with addiction and loss may finish him before he finishes the task.

title: As Good as Dead
description: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

title: Cut Throat City
description: When Hurricane Katrina devastates New Orleans, four desperate friends band together to pull off a daring heist in the heart of the city.

title: Mac & Devin Go to High School
description: A smart teenager (Wiz Khalifa) tries to help a long-term student (Snoop Dogg) finally graduate from high school.

title: Snoop Dogg's Hood of Horror
description: A tagger discovers gangsters don't always die hard, an heir to a Texas oil fortune can't afford to stay alive, and a huge rap star finds a few skeletons in his dressing room ... and they are kicking his door down.

title: Precious
description: Pregnant and abused, a Harlem teen (Gabourey Sidibe) enrolls in an alternative school in an attempt to bring value to her life.

title: Cooley High
description: Two high-school pals (Glynn Turman, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs) hang out, face a teacher and flee the police in 1964 urban Chicago.

title: American Violet
description: An ACLU attorney and a former narcotics officer help a single mother (Nicole Beharie) in her battle to establish that she was wrongly arrested on drug-dealing charges.
